depiction.primary_object: SIM card or SD card outline with cut top-left corner
modifiers: diagonal slash line from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single object in outline, front view, crossed out by diagonal slash

readings.meaning: no SIM card / remove or cancel SIM card

reasoning: The notched rectangle with a diagonal slash represents 'no SIM card' or 'no SD card' (or removing/deactivating one). It fits specific tech, travel, and phone-handover tasks like removing a SIM before selling a phone or troubleshooting a missing card error, though the bare outline without contact pads can be confused with a crossed-out document page.
